The '''M-L4 seeker mine''' was an homing [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The M-L4 was capable of detecting enemies in a wide area and automatically maneuvered itself to intercept hostile [[Starship/Legends|starships]] before detonating, though the combined chemical and particle payload of the mine was absorbable by shields.
